EXTRACTION_REQUIREMENTS.SOURCE_RULE: Use only the exact artifact whose SHA256 matches R4_1_SHA256.
SEARCH_RULES: Perform deterministic recovery only from legitimate controlled project sources already established.
Do not broaden into generic web search.
Do not reconstruct the STEP file.
Do not use a different revision.
Do not use a visually equivalent STEP or proxy geometry.
Do not infer, estimate, repair, reverse-engineer, or invent missing geometry.
EXTRACTION_REQUIREMENTS.TARGET_RESULT: The recovered file must be byte-for-byte identified by the required SHA256 before any B01-B06 extraction is accepted.
EXTRACTION_REQUIREMENTS.MISSING_DATA_RULE: If a required field is not explicitly recoverable from the matched artifact, record it as unavailable; do not manufacture a value or substitute another source.

SHA_VERIFICATION.METHOD: Independent SHA256 calculation on the recovered R4.1/R4.1.step file.

EXTRACTION_VERIFICATION.METHOD: Independent second verification pass after initial B01-B06 extraction.
CHECKS: Confirm each B01-B06 feature is traceable to the matched source artifact.
Confirm BODY_ID and B_REP_REFERENCE identify the extracted source entities without ambiguity.
Confirm coordinate system, datum, orientation, travel, clearance, and PMI/tolerance fields were preserved exactly where present.
Confirm no substitute geometry, inferred dimensions, or cross-revision data entered the extraction.
Confirm SOURCE_SHA256 equals the authoritative R4_1_SHA256 for every accepted feature record.
Confirm extraction output is internally consistent and reproducible from the same source artifact.

VERIFICATION_REQUIREMENTS.ACCEPTANCE_RULE: Only a recovered artifact with exact SHA match followed by successful independent verification of all B01-B06 may be used to unblock P0-V0 exploratory fabrication.

P0_TARGETS.CONCEPT_STATUS: Accepted exploratory architecture; not under redesign in this handoff.
P0_TARGETS.UNBLOCK_CONDITION: B01-B06 extracted and independently verified from the exact SHA-matched artifact.

IDENTITY.SHA_ROLE: Immutable source identity; filename alone is insufficient.

LINEAGE: Record the exact controlled-project source location from which the artifact was recovered.
Record the exact artifact path/name used for SHA verification.
Record extraction version and extraction date.
Maintain a direct trace from every B01-B06 record to the matched source artifact and source B-rep/body reference.
NO_BYPASS: No geometry may be accepted solely because it looks correct.
No geometry from another revision may be merged into this extraction.
No inferred dimensions, coordinates, tolerances, travel values, or clearances may be promoted to authoritative data.
No reconstruction is permitted when the authoritative artifact is absent or SHA-mismatched.
R4.1_TRACEABILITY_REQUIREMENTS.FINAL_HANDOFF_TO_PETER: Return the recovery result, SHA result, source location, B01-B06 extraction records, and independent verification result for Peter review.

STOP_RULE: If the artifact is absent or SHA-mismatched, stop immediately after recording the exact artifact searched, exact locations searched, exact SHA result, and exact owner/action required to make the authoritative artifact available. Do not create substitute geometry.
